# projects
---

<!-- Generated by docs/5-reference/generate.py from the doc comments: do not edit. -->

Package projects is the work the artist draws to order: who asked for it, how far it has got on a board of stages, when it is due and what it is paid. Delivering a project records its sale.

| Name | What it is |
|---|---|
| `var Stages = []Stage{ ... }` | Stages lists the stages in the board's order. |
| `func DeadlineWords(deadline, today calendar.Date) string` | DeadlineWords says when a project is due, counted from today, or "" when it has no deadline. |
| `func DeliveredWords(delivered time.Time) string` | DeliveredWords says the day of the month a project was delivered, "Entregado el 18". |
| `func Matches(project Project, customer, query string) bool` | Matches tells whether a project, made for customer, answers a search: its title or the customer's name holds query, whatever the case and the accents. |
| `func ProblemWords(code Code) string` | ProblemWords is what the artist reads about a problem, in Spanish; the code when it has no words. |
| `func StageWords(stage Stage) string` | StageWords is a stage's name, in Spanish. |
| `type Code string` | Code is a stable name for what went wrong, for programs to check and people to search for. |
| `const CodeBlankTitle Code = "projects.blank-title" ...` | Error codes of this package. |
| `type Error struct{ ... }` | Error is a failure of the projects: its code, what it was about and what lay underneath. |
| `type Project struct{ ... }` | Project is one commission. |
| `type Screens struct{ ... }` | Screens are the projects pages: the board, and the editor of one project over it. |
| `func NewScreens(store *Store, people *customers.Store, products *catalogue.Store, ...) *Screens` | NewScreens draws the projects kept in store; openLink opens a customer's profile, and may be nil where nothing can open links. |
| `type Stage string` | Stage is a column of the projects board. |
| `const ToStart Stage = "TO_START" ...` | The stages, in the board's order. |
| `type Store struct{ ... }` | Store keeps the projects in the database. |
| `func NewStore(database *storage.Database, products *catalogue.Store, people *customers.Store, ...) *Store` | NewStore keeps projects in database, finding their products in products and their customers in people; tests pass a fixed clock and fixed ids. |
